headline: Premier League live updates: Spurs scoreless again; Chelsea shock draw vs. Hull
description: Tottenham's scoreless streak in the Premier League extended beyond six hours as they drew 0-0 with Everton. Up next: Arsenal at Sunderlands. Earlier unbeaten Hull City shocked Chelsea with a 2-2 draw on a busy Saturday across Europe.

headline: Andoni Iraola cites 'lack of freshness' after Liverpool's draw with Fulham
description: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola said his players were tired but refused to use it as an excuse after being held to a 0-0 draw by Fulham at Anfield.

headline: Xabi Alonso wants more 'boring' wins as Chelsea draw with Hull
description: Xabi Alonso says his Chelsea side must show more desire in defence, and warns it will take time to fix their frailties at the back after they drew 2-2 with Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday.

headline: Nicol: Chelsea's defence isn't good enough to win the title

headline: In-form Hull show why Chelsea fans are in for a rough ride this season
description: Chelsea have a star-studded attack which has saved them many times already this season, but their defense was exposed again vs. an impressive Hull City.
